newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ "tankan" shows Japan business outlook worsened.
newsitem.headline: BOJ "tankan" shows Japan business outlook worsened.

text.p: The Bank of Japan's (BOJ) "tankan" short-term corporate survey in August, released on Wednesday, showed that the business outlook among major manufacturers had worsened since the previous survey in May, with the August diffusion index for major manufacturers at minus 7.
BUSINESS DIFFUSION INDEX MAY AUG DEC
Major manufacturers -3 -7 0
Major non-manufacturers -9 -4 -3

(NOTE: In the last survey in May, the index forecast for major makers was zero for August. December figures are forecasts.)

(Percentage of firms seeing demand exceeding supply
minus those seeing supply exceeding demand)

(Percentage of firms saying inventories were excessive
minus those saying they were insufficient)

(Percentage of firms saying product prices were rising
minus those saying they were falling)

(Percentage of firms saying they had excess workers

SEP(F'CAST) DEC(F'CAST)
Major firms +1.37 +1.33

The business diffusion index, a key gauge of corporate sentiment, measures the percentage of firms which expect their business environment to improve minus the percentage of firms which expect it to worsen. The survey covered 9,635 companies, of which 712 were categorised as large.
